The *Rūpīduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 15.29) is a canonical Abhidhamma text belonging to the Paṭṭhāna, the seventh and final treatise of the Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka. The section examines conditional relations by synthesizing the dyad concerning material form (*rūpīduka*) with the triad of wholesome, unwholesome, and undetermined phenomena (*kusalattika*).
